rules.statement: The proper evidence that a witness cannot be found is that the person whose duty it was to call him has made use of his legal powers under section 131 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: In my opinion the best evidence and the proper evidence that a witness cannot be found is. that the person whose duty it was to call him has made use of his legal powers under section 131 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 131 of the Civil Procedure Code
